scope: Complete indexed committed corpus, not official or exam-complete lists. Kentei collections are assigned-grade bins, not cumulative test scope.

policy.membership: All attested levels; distinct entries within each collection. Conflicts repeat across levels.
policy.displayPrecedence: Dictionary reading/meanings first, graded words fallback. Kanji metadata first, committed metadata fallback.
policy.identity: Exact printed form and reading identify vocabulary; never normalize or merge homographs. Missing Unicode glyphs use their source entry ID.
policy.scope: Complete indexed committed corpus, not official or exam-complete lists. Kentei collections are assigned-grade bins, not cumulative test scope.
policy.jlptKanji: Bundled editorial JLPT tags retained verbatim; N3 has no tagged kanji. Historical pre-2010 KANJIDIC levels are not mapped to modern JLPT levels.
policy.unknown: No attested label, or an unrecognized label kept verbatim; never infer a level from school grade or rank.
policy.relationships: Kentei related forms share an attested species ID, not necessarily a glyph or grade. Dictionary candidates require exact form/reading and reading restrictions; they do not classify every sense or authorize a canonical redirect.
policy.kanjiReadings: A kanji shows every reading: the listed readings first, then each further KANJIDIC2 reading, then each 常用漢字表 (2010) reading KANJIDIC2 lacks, marked as such. Nothing is dropped, merged or generated.

identity.dictionaryRule: Exact printed form and reading, respecting JMdict readingWrittenScopes. All candidates retained; no sense-level classification or automatic canonical redirect.
identity.dictionaryLinkScope: Every attested reading on a classified vocabulary printed key; unassigned words retain runtime targets but are not matched to JMdict here.
identity.kankenRelationshipRule: Shared source species_id only. Retain each entry_id, glyph and grade; never inherit metadata or grades across related forms.

auditedExclusions: No JLPT classification field; no frequency-based inference.
Historical jlpt_pre2010_editorial levels are not modern N1–N5; metadata only.

kanjiTrust.readingScope: Every kanji.json glyph and the 2,136 characters of the 2010 常用漢字表 (= strokes.json meta).
kanjiTrust.readingRule: Exact KANJIDIC2 on/kun strings in source order. The app lists kanji.json readings first, then each further KANJIDIC2 reading, then officialReadings; nothing is dropped or merged.

wordFill.rule: Only for a Jōyō kanji no shipped word list names (headwords, k lists, alternate spellings). JMdict entries written with it, never a search-only spelling (sK); reading allowed for that spelling; first gloss of the first sense allowed for both; common spellings first, rare (rK) last, then shorter, then sequence.

limitations: Complete indexed committed corpus, not official or exam-complete lists. Kentei collections are assigned-grade bins, not cumulative test scope.
Bundled editorial JLPT tags retained verbatim; N3 has no tagged kanji. Historical pre-2010 KANJIDIC levels are not mapped to modern JLPT levels.
Reading/meaning metadata is incomplete; missing fields remain empty rather than generated.
Missing Unicode glyph records retain source IDs and are not drawable characters.
Full JMdict has no JLPT classification field and cannot expand labelled lists by inference.

gapCensus.policy: Glyphless records and absent metadata are not broken canonical links. Missing on or kun alone is not proof of a metadata gap; a character need not have both.
